description: İki MCP sunucusunun araç kataloğu. input_schema alanı MCP JSON Schema'dır; ajanlar araç seçimi ve parametre doğrulaması için kullanır.

tools.name: search_sciencedirect
tools.description: Search Elsevier/ScienceDirect-indexed articles without an Elsevier API key. Uses OpenAlex (Elsevier publisher filter) and resolves exact ScienceDirect PII links via Crossref when possible. Results also include priority-ordered links for Ovid LWW, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink, Wiley and Taylor & Francis.

tools.name: search_pubmed
tools.description: Search PubMed via NCBI E-utilities (no API key required). Returns abstracts, DOIs and PMIDs; Elsevier DOIs get a ScienceDirect DOI link.

tools.name: search_europepmc
tools.description: Search Europe PMC (no API key required). Returns abstracts, DOIs, PMIDs, citation counts and open-access PDF links.

tools.name: search_all
tools.description: Combined search across OpenAlex (all publishers), PubMed and Europe PMC. Deduplicates results and ranks links in this order: Ovid LWW, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink, Wiley, Taylor & Francis. Set priority_only=true to restrict results to these publishers.

priority_only.description: Only return records that have a real publisher link in the allowed_publishers set.

allowed_publishers.description: Publisher/source allowlist. Default: Ovid LWW, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink, Wiley, Taylor & Francis.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Look up one article by DOI or PMID across OpenAlex and Europe PMC; returns metadata, abstract, citation count and priority-ordered publisher links.

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: Return priority-ordered links for one DOI or PMID: Ovid LWW, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink, Wiley, Taylor & Francis, then the DOI resolver. Also returns preferred_url and publisher_url.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List registered literature projects (shared registry with the paperqa-local MCP). Each project is isolated: own PDF folder, manifest CSV and PaperQA2 index. Shows per-project PDF counts, detected DOIs, manifest status, and files not yet in the manifest.

tools.name: project_audit
tools.description: Audit one registered project's PDFs without mixing projects: per unique DOI returns metadata (OpenAlex/Europe PMC, Crossref fallback), database provenance (found_in), Crossref vs OpenAlex citation counts, SCImago quartile, and OpenAlex retraction flags. This is the project-scoped version of the Ek C style metrics table.

project.description: Registered project name (see list_projects). Scopes local PDF lookups to that project's folder only; projects never mix.

tools.name: search_literature
tools.description: Find DOIs and metadata across OpenAlex, PubMed, Europe PMC and Crossref. By default only records with a real publisher link from the allowed set are returned (Ovid LWW, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink, Wiley, Taylor & Francis). Adds local_pdf when a matching PDF is already available; pass project=... to check only that project's folder.

sources.description: Metadata sources to query. Default: all available sources.

allowed_publishers.description: Publisher/source allowlist. Default: Ovid LWW, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink, Wiley, Taylor & Francis.

project.description: Registered project name (see list_projects). Scopes local PDF lookups to that project's folder only; projects never mix.

tools.name: deep_research
tools.description: Decompose a research question into facets (overview, reviews, prevalence, risk factors, interventions, qualitative) and run multi-source DOI searches. By default only allowed publisher records are returned. Pass subtopics to control the decomposition explicitly.

sources.description: Metadata sources to query. Default: all available sources.

allowed_publishers.description: Publisher/source allowlist. Default: Ovid LWW, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink, Wiley, Taylor & Francis.

tools.name: verify_doi_and_publisher
tools.description: Verify a DOI in Crossref and via doi.org, identify the publisher, resolve the Elsevier PII when present, and return the ScienceDirect and priority links.

tools.name: doi_provenance
tools.description: Report which metadata databases index a DOI (Crossref, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, PubMed), including each database's record ID and title. Use this to audit where a selected DOI came from.

tools.name: read_paper
tools.description: Read a full-text PDF from the local library (matched by DOI or title) or from an explicit pdf_path. With no arguments, lists the local library. Pass project=... to search only that project's folder.

project.description: Registered project name (see list_projects). Scopes local PDF lookups to that project's folder only; projects never mix.

tools.name: compare_studies
tools.description: Build a methods/sample/results/limitations table for DOIs, PMIDs, or a query. Uses local full-text PDFs when available, otherwise abstracts. Pass project=... so full texts are only taken from that project.

sources.description: Metadata sources to query. Default: all available sources.

project.description: Registered project name (see list_projects). Scopes local PDF lookups to that project's folder only; projects never mix.

tools.name: evidence_check
tools.description: Match claims against sentences in a local full-text PDF or abstract. Returns strong/moderate/weak/not_found verdicts and the best matching sentences. Pass project=... to restrict local PDF lookups to that project.

project.description: Registered project name (see list_projects). Scopes local PDF lookups to that project's folder only; projects never mix.

tools.name: export_review
tools.description: Save a cited review as Markdown, CSV, or JSON. With project, the file is written inside that project's output_directory (defaults to the project folder); otherwise inside REVIEW_OUTPUT_DIR. Accepts sections, references, and evidence-check claims.

project.description: Registered project name (see list_projects). Scopes local PDF lookups to that project's folder only; projects never mix.

tools.name: journal_rank
tools.description: Look up SCImago Journal Rank 2024 Q1-Q4 quartiles for journal titles. Reads a local CSV; does not call external services at runtime.

journals.description: Journal titles, e.g. ['Journal of Example Work'].

include_categories.description: Include SCImago subject categories and areas.

tools.name: analysis_updates
tools.description: Return the saved full-text citation audit for the active project. Includes page-level full-text quotes, translations, constructed sentences, abstract-vs-full-text corrections, document-level citation metrics, the claim evidence matrix, the risk-of-bias assessment, the source budget, and an optional gap analysis. Filter by DOI, entry_id, or query.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive search in headings, quotes, translations, notes, corrections, claim matrix, risk-of-bias records, source budget, and gap analysis.

project.description: Registered project name; reads that project's own analysis_json file instead of the global audit.

tools.name: library_status
tools.description: List PDFs in the local library with detected DOIs and titles. Pass project=... to scan only that registered project's folder.

project.description: Registered project name (see list_projects). Scopes local PDF lookups to that project's folder only; projects never mix.

tools.name: paperqa_projects
tools.description: Kayıtlı projeleri durumlarıyla listeler (izole PDF klasörü + manifest + indeks).

tools.name: paperqa_register_project
tools.description:
Bir PDF klasörünü izole proje olarak kaydeder ve manifest CSV üretir.

- DOI, dosya adından (``10.1007s...pdf`` gibi) veya ilk iki sayfadan algılanır.
- Metadata Crossref (yedek: OpenAlex) ile zenginleştirilir; API anahtarı gerekmez.
- Mevcut manifest ``refresh_manifest=True`` verilmedikçe korunur.
- Kayıtlı bir projenin klasörü veya alt klasör taraması değiştirilecekse
  ``refresh_manifest=True`` zorunludur; aksi hâlde eski manifest yeni
  klasörle karışır.
- DOI'si olmayan dosyalar varsayılan olarak manifeste alınmaz
  (``include_files_without_doi=True`` ile dahil edilir).
- Aynı DOI'ye çözülen ikinci dosya manifeste alınmaz; ``skipped_duplicate_doi``
  alanında raporlanır.
- ``output_directory`` verilmezse çıktılar proje klasörüne (``paper_directory``)
  yazılır; böylece raporlar baştan kullanıcının verdiği klasörde kalır.
- İndeks kurmak ayrı bir adımdır: ``paperqa_build_index``.

tools.name: paperqa_build_index
tools.description:
Projenin indeksini manifest üyeliğine göre kurar/günceller.

- İndekse yalnızca manifestteki dosyalar girer (klasör taraması değil).
- ``rebuild=True`` proje indeks klasörünü önce yedeğe taşır; kurulum
  başarısız olursa eski indeks geri getirilir.
- Diğer projelerin indekslerine dokunulmaz.

tools.name: paperqa_status
tools.description:
Bir projenin indeks durumunu (dosya, doküman, metin parçası) döndürür.

Manifest ile indeks arasındaki uyuşmazlıkları da raporlar: indekste eksik
dosyalar ve manifestte olmayan indeks kayıtları.

tools.name: paperqa_llm_status
tools.description:
Yerel llama.cpp sunucusunun erişilebilirliğini ve yüklü modelleri döndürür.

Sunucuyu **başlatmaz**; yalnızca durumu raporlar. ``paperqa_ask`` çağrısı
sunucu kapalıysa otomatik başlatır. llama.cpp'nin ``/v1/models`` uç noktası
sorgulanır.

tools.name: paperqa_search
tools.description:
Proje içinde semantik arama (yalnızca o projenin indeksi; LLM çağrılmaz).

Kanıt ve sayfa aralığı bulmak için kullanın; önemli alıntıları
``paperqa_read_pages`` ile doğrulayın.

tools.name: paperqa_read_pages
tools.description:
Projedeki bir PDF'ten sayfa metni okur (DOI → manifest eşlemesi).

Sayfa numaraları 1 tabanlıdır. ``paperqa_search`` sonucundaki alıntıları
bu araçla doğrulayın. DOI başka bir projede olsa bile burada bulunmaz.
Tek çağrıda en fazla 50 sayfa okunur.

tools.name: paperqa_ask
tools.description:
Proje indeksi üzerinde yerel LLM'e soru sorar (taslak cevap).

Yerel llama.cpp sunucusunu kullanır. Sunucu kapalıysa MCP onu otomatik
başlatır ve yalnızca kendisi başlattıysa boşta kalınca durdurur
(``PAPERQA_AUTO_START`` / ``PAPERQA_AUTO_STOP_IDLE``). CPU'da yavaştır ve
küçük modeller atıf hatası yapabilir. Cevabı taslak kabul edip her iddiayı
``paperqa_search`` veya ``paperqa_read_pages`` ile doğrulayın.
